title: Tsakonian Language (TSD) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Tsakonian is an endangered indigenous language of Greece. It belongs to the Indo-European language family. The language is used as a first language by older adults only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
